title: Discover credentials where they already live, with consent
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Offer to import keys from the environment, a workspace .env, and standard tool locations (aws credentials, gcloud ADC, gh auth token) one source at a time, only after an explicit yes, never silently. Tests zc_key_sources_*.
